agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/lexer.py: bytes input to Lexer.get_tokens() was incorrectly raising TypeError instead of being decoded. Swapped the isinstance branches so bytes are decoded (using provided encoding, utf-8 fallback, then unicode-escape) and TypeError is only raised for genuinely unsupported types. Verified parsing/formatting of bytes SQL (including non-ASCII) works again, and TypeError is still raised for invalid types like int.
